On-Demand Premier Support
A full suite of easy-to-use enterprise-grade IT tools. Unlimited users. Unlimited usage.
Genuity Networking Monitoring software enables your team to diagnose performance issues and solve problems in minutes instead of days or hours.
Buying power = lower prices. We’re stronger together.

Genuity is built by IT pros, for IT pros.

Genuity staff is very quick and responsive, always going the extra mile, getting to the resolution much quicker than others. Some things need that hands-on approach... that's what you get with Genuity.

Good customer service is one of, if not the most important element in your success. Yet, most software vendors treat customer support as an afterthought with slow response times, subpart answers, little to no onboarding support, etc.

With Genuity, support is immediate, with real-time chat functionality built right into our platform so that your questions can be answered almost instantaneously. We also offer free onboarding assistance, so setup is quick, painless, and configured to meet your needs.
Conceived by IT pros, built by innovators, and improved together.
By IT pros, for IT pros.

Genuity came about as a reaction to the predatory practices and unfair pricing structures in the IT Market. With over 40 years of comibined experience in the IT world we had experiended firsthand the blackbox that is IT, so we decided to create something different. We wanted to develop an independent, unbiased, and objective information source — no marketing fluff, just the facts.
This is what happens when technologists, businesses, and entrepreneurs get together to change the status quo - you create a new logic.
Our guiding principles in creating IT Solutions that are fair, accessible, and transparent.
Our work is only as successful as our clients - if we make your work more simple, easier, and more productive, we win.
We want to build something we'll be proud of. We never sacrifice our long-term vision for short-term gains.
No matter how small, every project or assignment should be tackled with as much attention to detail as anything else.
Trusted by 10,000+ IT Pros at thousands of companies.
Maintain security & productivity across all devices with advanced identity & features.
You’re (probably) paying too much for your Microsoft Cloud solutions.
premier Microsoft support.

Genuity is a certified Microsoft Solutions Partner. That means not only can we offer you discounted Microsoft licenses on the products you already use, but we can do so without any interruption in your service. That's right, with Genuity's streamlined transition service you'll enjoy simplified invoicing, more money in your pocket, and our US-based Premier Support team, all with no downtime.

Whether it's deploying Microsoft Office 365, integrating SharePoint, or migrating to Azure cloud services, we have the expertise to deliver successful outcomes. We follow industry best practices and ensure that our solutions are scalable, secure, and efficient.
Your perfect partner is Premier.
Our US-based support team exceeds the standards for Microsoft's Premier Support.

Our dedicated support team is available round the clock to assist clients with any issues or concerns they may have. We strive to provide prompt and effective solutions to minimize downtime and maximize productivity.

With Genuity as your Microsoft partner not only will you save on your M365 licenses, but you'll save on Microsoft Copilot, too. Savings vary from plan-to-plan, but whatever savings we can find you we're sure that, from purchasing to productivity, your workflow will be forever enhanced.
